title: Suspended Floor Slab Assembly & On-Site Engineering Supervision
shortDescription: On-site construction management and suspended floor slab structural coordination in Lagos, Nigeria, capturing resident engineers verifying blueprints, drop beam rebar cages, and conduit embedment.
overview: Located in Lagos, Nigeria, this assignment showcases critical-path construction supervision and structural quality assurance on an elevated floor deck. Resident site engineers review structural working drawings directly on the slab prior to casting, inspecting marine board shuttering, main drop-beam rebar cages, two-way slab mesh, and MEP conduit routing.
objectives: Maintain strict blueprint fidelity on site, verify bar spacing and lap lengths per BS 8110 / Eurocode 2, coordinate MEP rough-ins before concrete pouring, and eliminate rework.
scopeOfWork: On-site blueprint verification, deck falsework and marine board inspection, drop-beam and two-way slab rebar QA/QC, electrical conduit coordination, and pre-pour engineer sign-off.
technicalApproach: Continuous supervisory drawing audits by resident project engineers, verifying tension anchorages, cranked bars, beam-column joint confinements, and cover spacers before monolithic concrete placement.
projectOutcome: Coordinated structural deck with verified rebar clearances and MEP embeds ready for monolithic concrete casting under strict supervision.
